articles.title: Casio's new rugged G-Shock with vibration alerts now available to buy
articles.summary: The G-Shock GD-350 watch, launched in 2013, has uniquely maintained its popularity for thirteen years, primarily due to its distinctive vibration alarm feature. This function has become increasingly scarce across the broader G-Shock range, making the GD-350 a noteworthy example of product longevity. The article likely discusses its sustained relevance in the market, showcasing how a specific characteristic can ensure a product's enduring appeal.

articles.title: Police arrest five people printing fake Rs 500 notes out of a private bungalow in Maharashtra
articles.summary: A joint operation by Nashik Rural Local Crime Branch, city police, Trimbakeshwar police, and forensic experts successfully busted a sophisticated counterfeit currency manufacturing unit operating from a private bungalow. This significant action highlights the vigilance of national law enforcement agencies in combating economic crimes and safeguarding the nation's financial integrity, demonstrating inter-agency coordination against illicit activities.
